subject: Is it OK to use the new version of R?

messages.author: 8d02e9dfa5f07921
messages.subject: Is it OK to use the new version of R?
parts:
I've just upgraded to R 3.3.0, and I'm finding that deployApp() is failing "Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Connection closed"

Is it possible that it's a version problem, or should I look elsewhere?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Is it OK to use the new version of R?
parts:
Unfortunately the .deb packages have not yet made it to CRAN, so shinyapps.io has not been able to update yet.
Within 2 hours of them hitting CRAN, we should be good to go.

My apologies for the unhelpful error message, it will be improved in the near future, hopefully before the next R update!
